mapper.select: select t.id,t.name,sum(if(sio.inout_type = 'IN',sio.inout_num,0)) as inValue,sum(if(sio.inout_type = 'OUT',sio.inout_num,0)) as outValue from emergency_supplies_type t left join emergency_supplies s on t.id = s.type left join emergency_supplies_inout_record sio on s.id = sio.supplies_id group by t.id
